about.title: Profile
about.lead: I work where operational detail matters: an invoice, a stock count, a cash register, a permission.
about.p1: I have spent more than three years building interfaces for administrative systems that people use every day. I have worked on electronic invoicing modules connected to SUNAT, inventory control, point of sale and business dashboards.
about.p2: My work starts by understanding the business rule and ends with an interface the team can use without a manual. I care about maintainable code, reusable components and performance on real connections.
